liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **All Along The Watchtower** (3 reviews): The Watchtower is described as steaming hot, a highlight of the show's close; Watchtower is described as hard-charging, one of the show's better moments [14][17][19]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): Iko Iko is called lively, one of the show's few real highlights [17]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Cassidy is mentioned among the jewels of this show [19]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 other source): Scarlet Begonias went into Fire On The Mountain and then returned to Scarlet Begonias [4]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Fire is judged to lack urgency [17]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Other One into Morning Dew is singled out as the heat of the second set [14]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Morning Dew a killer, a standout of the show [19]
- **Black Muddy River** (1 other source): Black Muddy River was the encore [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **Round & Round**: back after 150 archived shows (748 days); rare: 8 archived performances [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-11-15.senn441.flair.24535.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 138 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1987-11-15.sbd.fix.uh_clem.27307.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 135 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd87-11-15.sbd.nawrocki.4750.sbefail.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 19 songs; 135 min; rated 4.42/5 by 12 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the recording quality good, and says the band sounded fully on form; Reviewer calls the sound quality of this soundboard-source circulating copy superb [13][14]
- **gd87-11-15.sennheiser.french.17185.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 137 min; rated 3.25/5 by 8 [7]. Said about its sound: Garcia's vocals come across strong, while the guitar tone sounds somewhat synthesized, typical of the period; The taper says he won't remaster to remove the cuts on disc 2, so they remain [9][16]

## Around the show

- For this listener it was the first Garcia show since his 1986 coma, so it felt special [9]
- The taper recorded from the 20th row near center, on Phil's side of the stage [18]
- Tape was flipped after West L.A. Fadeaway and after Cassidy, with a few pauses between songs [1]
- Reviewer ranks this among the best shows of the Dead's later years, on a par with 9.18.87 [12]
- The same taper, using the same mics, also made a circulating recording of the 11-13-87 show [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-11-15.senn441.flair.24535.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jason Flair; source: Sennheiser441>tcd5m>cas(1st Gen Copy Made On Matching Calibrated Dragons metal master,metal copy) [1]
- **gd1987-11-15.sbd.fix.uh_clem.27307.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by uh_clem; source: This source is a fixed version of Doug Nawrocki's seed (etree shnid=4750). [2]. Also: Uhclem fixed this copy in December 2004, seamlessly joining the Drumz and Space tracks; His fixes also included retracking disc 2, correcting DC offset per set, and compressing to FLAC [2]
- **gd87-11-15.sbd.nawrocki.4750.sbefail.shnf**: source: SBD > MC > Sonic Solutions > Pre-FM Dat @44.1 [4]. Also: Doug Nawrocki transferred the pre-FM DAT using a DA-P1, Delta Audiophile 2496, Sound Forge 5, CDWave and mkwACT [4]
- **gd87-11-15.sennheiser.french.17185.sbeok.shnf**: source: Digital Ambient recording by M. French 20th row near center (Phil's side) Sennheiser MKE 2002 (HRTF, worn in/on hat) > WM-D6C (dolby C)analog>CD via hardware… [7]. Also: Reviewer queries whether the recording is ORTF, a French Radio technique using two cardioid mics 17cm apart angled at 110 degrees; The taper used Sennheiser MKE 2002 microphones, which differ from the similar MKE 2 model [15][16]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1987-11-15 Sun Long Beach Arena, Long Beach, CA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1428020096193/grateful-dead-1987-11-15-sun-long-beach) [24]
- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1987-11-15 Sun Long Beach Arena, Long Beach, CA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1428020096193/grateful-dead-1987-11-15-sun-long-beach) [25]
